title: Run the production recovery acceptance journey
description: Create one public-UI Playwright journey covering creation, restart, offline editing, safe-area refusal/override, setup attestation, uncalibrated preparation, export, local deletion, fresh-context import, recovery, update behavior, failures, and keyboard operation.
acceptanceCriteria: The journey uses only public UI, keyboard input, downloadable artifacts, and import controls
It covers every PRD 28 named stage in order and asserts durable state at restart/reload boundaries
Safe-area override, setup attestation, and generated output retain uncalibrated and evidence-safe disclosures
Injected update, write, generation, and import failure branches preserve recoverable state and show no false success
The journey passes against a production build with network blocked after installation

steps.details: Map the named flow to public actions, keyboard inputs, durability markers, downloaded artifacts, semantic statuses, focus targets, and canonical expectations.
Create/edit/restart/offline/override/attest/prepare/export/delete/import/recover through UI using one small deterministic fixture.
Inject a waiting worker, verify dirty-draft refusal, explicit consent, controlled reload, cancellation, and focus-safe recovery.
Reuse targeted hooks to inject one write, generation, and import failure and assert preserved state plus actionable status.
Execute the focused test against the built application with post-install network blocking and retain traces only on failure.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; use one compact fixture and one focused Playwright project.
Do not substitute direct IndexedDB mutation for public workflow actions except bounded failure injection hooks.
